Market today: The Fed held rates steady, which is generally positive for growth and tech stocks, but the divided vote shows underlying uncertainty. This mixed signal could keep tech/chip names volatile, especially with individual investors dumping stocks.

Your holdings: SOXL (-60.75%) and SPAL (-56.06%) are in dire straits. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning they decay and amplify drops, which is extra painful on margin. SMH (-18.84%) also needs close attention.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on your stops for SOXL and SPAL. Also, watch for any follow-through on Apple's record high, as it's a big part of your tech exposure.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and respecting stops to protect your capital in this uncertain environment.
plays: SOXL: Your -60.75% loss on this leveraged ETF is extreme; the 200 stop is ineffective. Consider a hard trim or exit to manage risk.
SPAL: This new leveraged position is down -56.06%. Re-evaluate your stop at 21.38 and consider reducing exposure due to decay and margin risk.
QQQ/SMH: With QQQ down -5.89% and SMH down -18.84%, ensure your stops are respected to prevent further margin-amplified losses.
